# VAYU

> VAYU is a neighbourhood-level air pollution hotspot map for Kolkata and India. It combines citizen photo reports, Arduino IoT air sensors and satellite air-quality data (Copernicus CAMS via Open-Meteo), and uses Google Gemini AI to detect pollution hotspots street by street and alert municipal teams. Built by team Doomsday for the Google Cloud hackathon (Track 2: CleanAir & Clear Streets).

- Website: https://vayuai.vercel.app
- Live hotspot map: https://vayuai.vercel.app/map
- Source code: https://github.com/chanchaltut/vayu
- Area: Kolkata, Salt Lake (Bidhannagar), Bhowanipore and Howrah, West Bengal; live AQI and weather work for any location in India
- Languages: English, Hindi, Bengali, Odia, Gujarati, Marathi, Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, Kannada, Punjabi, Assamese

## What you can do on VAYU

- [Check current AQI and weather](https://vayuai.vercel.app/#home): live US AQI, temperature and a 5-day forecast for your location
- [Report pollution](https://vayuai.vercel.app/#report): upload a photo of smoke, burning waste or dust; Gemini Vision rates its severity
- [Detect and predict](https://vayuai.vercel.app/#detect): AI hotspot detection, hotspot map, past and next-24-hour AQI
- [Act](https://vayuai.vercel.app/#act): confirmed hotspots with location, recommended action and SMS/WhatsApp dispatch to field teams
- [FAQ](https://vayuai.vercel.app/#faq)
